name: Analysis of Indeterminate Structures
description: Static determinacy and stability; Method of consistent deformations with matrix formulation with application to indeterminate beams, trusses and frames; Kinematic determinacy; Slope-deflection method with applications to beams and frames under varying support conditions, loading, support settlements, dealing with symmetry and anti-symmetry, Analysis of non-sway and sway frames; Matrix methods; Flexibility and stiffness method for computer applications including computational aspects; Applications to space trusses and frame.
